message: The other day, I was in the kitchen when I suddenly remembered my buddy Steve's advice about keeping a fire extinguisher handy. I thought, "I’ll never need that," until the smoke alarm started beeping. Turns out, I had left a pan on the stove a bit too long. After I opened the windows and got everything under control, I couldn’t help but feel a little smug thinking, "Thanks, Steve!" It’s funny how those little reminders can be lifesavers. Have you ever had a moment where preparedness paid off unexpectedly?
